## Cloud answer (cloud#3334 item 2): registered service, not a factory — the door sees it

**Premise:** `b029c9036f` (PR #26305) is an ancestor of cloud's pin `6390fe52`.

- `SecurityEnterprisePlugin.start()` registers the resolver with `ctx.registerService('hierarchy-scope-resolver', this.resolver)`, eagerly ([`packages/security-enterprise/src/plugin.ts:80`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/b060341f/packages/security-enterprise/src/plugin.ts#L80), called at [`:90`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/b060341f/packages/security-enterprise/src/plugin.ts#L90); a `kernel:ready` hook re-runs it idempotently). No `registerServiceFactory` anywhere in cloud for this service. It is mounted per plan by the capability loader ([`packages/objectos-runtime/src/capability-loader.ts:706`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/b060341f/packages/objectos-runtime/src/capability-loader.ts#L706)).
- **Test (objectstack-ai/cloud#3339):** the real `ArtifactKernelFactory` plan-capability boot now also calls the protocol's own door probe `hierarchyResolverMounted()` (the `getServicesRegistry().get(...)` read PR #26305 added): `true` on Enterprise, `false` on Free, Team, plan-less and Business ([`artifact-kernel-factory.plan-capabilities.test.ts:99`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/b060341f/packages/objectos-runtime/src/artifact-kernel-factory.plan-capabilities.test.ts#L99)). So a licensed kernel's `unit_and_below` permission set passes the door, and a community kernel's is refused 422.

Nothing to move back to objectstack: the door's snapshot read is correct for cloud. The two hosted posture runs (200 licensed / 422 community) belong to the #26059 Q4 cloud checklist card as scenarios.
